server.description: The seshi server this CLI talks to (seshi login --server).

local.description: The old name of [serverless] (F11.1): config names a server config whose [store] gives the bucket. Still read; seshi config check prints the new table.

config.description: A server config (seshi.toml) naming the bucket; ~ is the home folder. Its keys must be able to write the bucket.

owner.description: The owner id sessions are stored under; user, else the OS user, when unset.

serverless.description: Serverless mode (F11): this machine runs the pipeline and writes its owner's folder of a shared bucket directly; the bucket's permissions decide what it may do. Set server or serverless, not both.

url.description: The bucket and prefix sessions are written to: s3://bucket/prefix, r2://bucket/prefix, az://container/prefix, gs://bucket/prefix or file:///path. Required unless config names a server config with a [store].

endpoint.description: An S3-compatible endpoint, the Azure blob endpoint, or the GCS JSON API root, as [store] endpoint.

account_id.description: Cloudflare account id for r2://, as [store] account_id.

account_name.description: Azure storage account for az://, as [store] account_name.

owner.description: The owner id sessions are stored under; user, else the OS user, when unset.

config.description: A local server config (seshi.toml) layered over the bucket's shared config/seshi.toml; ~ is the home folder.

search.description: This machine's search index in serverless mode (F11.9).

enabled.description: Serverless mode: whether this machine keeps a search index (F11.9); the shared config's search.enabled when unset.

scope.description: Serverless mode: which sessions the index holds: mine, visible (yours and the org's) or all (also others' owner-only sessions).

user.description: The username stated with the org key (X5.7); else git user.email, then the OS user.

theme.description: Terminal colours (B1.4): auto detects the background.

keychain.description: Keep credentials in the OS keychain (F8.2). false keeps them in credentials.json (mode 0600) next to this file, for machines whose keychain prompts, hangs or is absent.

enabled.description: Capture for this user (F9.5, global level).

paths.description: Rules by folder; the longest match decides.

path.description: A folder; ~ is the home folder. Matched by path prefix.

capture.description: Capture sessions under it, or not.

items.description: A personal capture rule for a folder (F9.5).

remotes.description: The org rule (F9.5): when set, only repos with a git remote matching one of these patterns are captured (github.com/acme, github.com/acme/*). It can only turn capture off.

exclude.description: An exclude list of this machine's, added to the server's (the org's list, [capture] exclude, which the uploader downloads): sessions in these repositories (owner/name on any host, host/owner/name on one) or folders (starting with /, ~, a drive or \\server, and everything under them) are never captured. * matches within a path segment, ** across any number of them; blank entries and # comments are skipped. It can only turn capture off.

redact_tool_calls.description: A list of this machine's, added to the server's ([capture] redact_tool_calls, which the uploader downloads), of places whose sessions are uploaded with every tool call's input and output replaced by [redacted:tool-call]: prompts, replies, reasoning, tool names, call ids, their order and whether each failed are kept. Entries are written and matched as in capture.exclude, which wins for a place on both lists.

labels.description: Labels attached to each session when it is first seen (keys [a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}, values up to 512 characters, at most 32): every key but paths is a label, a string or { env = "NAME" }. Per key, a [[labels.paths]] entry wins, then these, then the repo's .seshi/config.toml.

paths.description: Labels by folder; they win over the labels set here.

path.description: A folder; ~ is the home folder. Matched as [[capture.paths]] is.

env.description: An environment variable of the agent the session runs in; the label is absent when it is unset or empty.

anyOf.description: A value read from the agent's environment when the session is first seen.

additionalProperties.description: A label's value: a string, or { env = "NAME" }.

items.description: Labels for sessions in a folder: every other key is a label. The longest matching folder wins, key by key.

env.description: An environment variable of the agent the session runs in; the label is absent when it is unset or empty.

anyOf.description: A value read from the agent's environment when the session is first seen.

additionalProperties.description: A label's value: a string, or { env = "NAME" }.
